name: Toyota Parts Distribution Center - Mansfield MA

fieldNotes.facilityType: Toyota Parts Distribution Center (Boston-region PDC), 440 Forbes Blvd, Mansfield MA — a regional service-parts warehouse for Toyota's New England dealer network, in the Forbes Blvd / Cabot industrial park.
fieldNotes.buildingIdentification: Resolved to the white-roof warehouse at ~42.0168, -71.2344. Street View at the Forbes Blvd entrance shows monument signage, an American flag and a building with trailers staged alongside; satellite confirms the dock bank, drop yard and employee parking. The roster's GEOMETRIC_CENTER point sits on this building. High confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The entrance off Forbes Blvd is an open driveway — no barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth was visible at the road in 2025-06 Street View or in z20 satellite. The truck driveway runs straight into the dock yard. Classified truckGate false (open site). A small structure beside the employee-parking lot is an ancillary building, not a gate booth. Flagged uncertain — perimeter security at the dock yard could not be fully ruled out.
fieldNotes.guardShack: False — no gate, so no guard booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The building's NW face is a single dock bank — ~18 dock doors with trailers (green/orange/white) backed into most. Banded 10-25.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A drop yard at the NW corner holds ~20+ parked trailers in rows; banded 10-25; dropYard true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved truck apron between the dock face and the drop yard gives interior queue room (drivewayLong true).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock activity is on the single NW face — shipping and receiving not on separate building faces. False.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the NW edge and crosses Forbes Blvd near the facility, but it serves the adjacent corridor / neighboring buildings — no spur clearly enters the Toyota parcel itself. Classified false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Suburban Mansfield MA industrial park — edge-of-town setting with woods around the parcel; per the rubric's tie-break toward Rural for small-town industrial, classified Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~16 acres for the building + dock yard + drop yard + employee parking.
